# Tripo API v3 response fixtures

Copied verbatim from the response examples in the public Tripo developer docs
(retrieved 2026-10-29):

- `create_task.json`, `task_success.json` - https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/docs/generation-text-to-model/standard and /en/docs/task-query
- `upload.json` - https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/docs/files
- `balance.json` - https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/docs/account
- `error_insufficient_credits.json` - https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/docs/error-handling

Used only by tests. Production code never reads these files.
